title: QualityReport
description: v2 of the Novel Quality Center's EVALUATIVE report (ADR-003). BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE superset of v1 (anes:contract:quality-report:1.0): every v1 score dimension is preserved so existing consumers (SCORE_DIMENSIONS, RevisionController, Review-Panel synthesis, Dashboard) keep working, and a v1 report still validates against the v1 schema. v2 DECOMPOSES the single `commercial` dimension into operable commercial signals (retention/subscription/payoff/curiosity/promise_delivery/serial_sustainability/reader_drop_risk) while KEEPING `commercial` as a roll-up. Structural invariants are unchanged: axis is const 'evaluative', gating is const false — a quality report can NEVER gate a build (ADR-003). SAFETY IS SPLIT ACROSS BOTH AXES: `scores.safety_risk` here is the SUBJECTIVE edginess judgment (evaluative, never gates); the DETERMINISTIC red-line check (banned terms, platform hard-lines) is a separate gate artifact and is NOT this report. The report rides the Runtime envelope beside the draft, never inside the frozen ChapterDraft schema.

scores.description: 0-100 per dimension. The 8 v1 dimensions are REQUIRED (backward compat). The v2 commercial-decomposition dimensions are OPTIONAL so a v1 report still satisfies this block. NOTE the two inverted dims where LOWER is better: originality_risk, reader_drop_risk, safety_risk.

retention.description: Does this chapter make the reader continue to the next one.

subscription.description: Does this chapter build willingness to pay / subscribe.

payoff.description: Quality of爽点 delivery — was a promised reward actually cashed in.

curiosity.description: Motivation to open the NEXT chapter (open-rate driver).

promise_delivery.description: Did the chapter deliver on the commercial promise it set up. BEST-EFFORT until Phase 4.2 grounds it against Chapter-IR payoff_target.

pacing.description: Rhythm/density; complements the deterministic pacing analysis (P22/P23).

character_growth.description: Traceable character movement this chapter (grounded further by Phase 4.3 character-runtime).

serial_sustainability.description: Can this line/engine sustain a long serial (100万字+).

reader_drop_risk.description: INVERTED: higher = more likely readers abandon here.

safety_risk.description: INVERTED, SUBJECTIVE edginess only (0=safe, 100=risky). The DETERMINISTIC red-line gate is a separate artifact, not this score.

predictions.description: PREDICTIVE signals. Never gate; use for RELATIVE comparison between revisions only, not as absolute truth (ADR-003). v2 keeps the v1 keys and adds commercial-conversion signals.

panel.description: Present when this report is the SYNTHESIS of a multi-model review panel (P10). Panelists score independently; synthesis weights each on its specialty dimensions and surfaces disagreement. The synthesized report is still a valid QualityReport (axis/gating invariants hold), so all consumers are unchanged.

disagreement.description: Per-dimension spread (max-min) across non-degraded panelists. High spread = the panel disagrees; a human should look.
